name: app.doitlist/mcp
title: Do It List
description: Drive Do It List task trees over MCP: read, create, and update nested tasks with rolled-up progress.

host.description: Host and port of your Do It List instance's MCP endpoint; the self-hosted default port is 4004. Hosted TLS deployments use their own https URL.
